paragraphs: R' Yochanan of Beit Guvrin. See the entry R' Yonatan of Beit Guvrin.[^1]

notes.text: דבית גוברין is rendered “of Beit Guvrin” in both names. Yochanan and Yonatan remain different supplied given names, with both abbreviated titles R'.
